profile.Name: Screamer the False
profile.Job: Guard of the Tower of Abuse
profile.Personality: A Skeleton of the old empire who still guards his post with a heavy polearm, long after anyone gave him orders.
profile.Backstory: One of the remnants of the Second Empire, he keeps watch at the Tower of Abuse.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Cold and clipped, like a soldier reciting orders.
